description: The jobs choose_stack can compare (database, auth, hosting, transactional and inbound email, object storage, LLM APIs, payments, sandboxes, browser automation, queues…) with how many vendors each has, plus the volume units and aliases it accepts. Stackcut stores the arguments of tool calls to improve its recommendations (vendor names, prices, seats, features, usage numbers, billing amounts and project descriptions; account keys only as a one-way hash, billing and validation sources not at all; never IP addresses). Tool results are summarized; exit tools log only result counts, qualification flags and public evidence statuses, not answer contents. Don't send personal data or secrets.
name: list_stack_jobs
title: List stack jobs
